log_health.last_line: 2026-10-01 17:46:54,132 | INFO | feed updated | new=1 active=239 signal=+0.441 adjustment=+4.41

review.summary: Supporting-log integrity passed across all 3,362 published rows, but model-performance evidence is limited: only 2 accepted paper orders, 2 fills, and 1 realized close occurred. No threshold, confirmation, risk-cap, or exit-rule changes are justified. Keep the system PAPER ONLY and prioritize SHADOW attribution and missing-pipeline instrumentation.
findings: Observed: integrity analysis covered all 3,362 published rows across 15 analyzed tables and reported no duplicate decision IDs, orphan attempts, accepted attempts lacking order IDs, duplicate fill order IDs, unresolved ZPTA returns, or database errors.

Observed: four tables were empty: financial_leverage_shadow, financial_leverage_signals, financial_leverage_outcomes, and zpta_shadow_trades. Therefore there is no XLF/FAS/FAZ signal or forward-outcome evidence and no ZPTA shadow-trade P/L evidence.

Observed: 2,935 decisions produced 3 BUY, 1 SELL, and 2,931 HOLD actions. The funnel recorded 13 raw threshold crossings, while its side counts total 14 events (11 BUY and 3 SELL); this likely reflects one non-crossing funnel event, but the supplied aggregates do not identify it.

Observed: funnel dispositions were 2 submitted, 10 awaiting confirmation, and 2 rejected by MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS. Order-attempt logs show 2 accepted submissions and 2 blocks before submission, with no submit failures. These gate counts agree with supporting-log analysis.

Observed: accepted-order activity was balanced at one paper buy and one paper sell. The AAPL buy requested $2,500; the AMZN sell shows $2,500.85 notional. Both accepted orders filled. Only the AMZN close generated realized P/L: +$0.91. This single realization is insufficient for performance or threshold calibration.

Observed: the dashboard's $10,006.84 exposure is a mark-to-market snapshot across four open positions, not requested order notional. It is $6.84 above the configured $10,000 cap, plausibly due to price movement; the evidence does not establish that a new order breached the pre-trade cap. The four-position cap did block two later attempts.

Observed: symbol threshold behavior differed. XOM had the highest average score (54.683), maximum 79.632, and average geo adjustment 2.932 but no final BUY/SELL action. TSLA reached 78.849 without a final action. AAPL, AMZN, and NVDA generated BUY actions; AMZN generated the only SELL. Confirmation and position gates prevent interpreting score maxima as orders.
Observed: VIX adjustments were negligible on average by symbol, approximately -0.005 to +0.011. VIX was 16.38 at the dashboard snapshot. No evidence supports changing VIX sensitivity.

Observed: geo context materially affected XOM and, to a lesser degree, GLD. The geo feed had 239 active events, no logged errors, 43 warnings, and conflicting bullish and bearish oil headlines. No component-level forward outcomes isolate geo contribution, so its causal value is unknown.

Observed: premarket produced five BULLISH snapshots, with SPY +0.328% and QQQ +0.573% gaps, but XLF/FAS/FAZ gaps were null. The end-of-day dashboard showed premarket adjustment 0.0, consistent with the configured 60-minute active window, but no tagged forward outcomes establish whether the early bias helped.
Observed: social sentiment was explicitly unavailable. It must not be treated as a model input for this review.

Observed: market-regime SHADOW recorded 66 of 66 snapshots as RISK_ON and all 11 mapped decisions as ALLOW_EQUITY. This confirms operation in one regime only, not effectiveness across regimes or of a regime gate.

Observed: ZPTA remained SHADOW-only, used delayed Yahoo data, and its asset preflight was active but non-tradable. It generated 300 predictions and 272 resolved predictions but zero shadow trades. Each model at a given horizon has identical sample count and average return, suggesting shared underlying forward-return labels rather than model-trigger-specific trade outcomes; this is a hypothesis requiring instrumentation review.

Observed: ZPTA continuation/pullback/reclaim accuracy was 29.17%-35% with negative average forward returns, while exhaustion accuracy was 60%-70.83% under the same negative returns. These samples exceed 12 per reported model/horizon, but one day, shared observations, no shadow trades, and unclear trigger conditioning make threshold calibration unsafe.

proposals.title: Restore XLF/FAS/FAZ SHADOW coverage with explicit availability rows
proposals.target: financial-leverage SHADOW collector and XLF/FAS/FAZ premarket preflight
proposals.current: Financial-leverage snapshot, signal, and outcome tables contain zero rows; premarket gaps for XLF, FAS, and FAZ are null despite financial_leverage_shadow_enabled=true.
proposals.proposed: On every scheduled SHADOW cycle, write one status row per XLF/FAS/FAZ containing provider, quote/bar timestamp, availability, stale age, and failure reason. Emit candidate snapshots only from valid inputs and attach 5/15/30/60-minute outcomes when due. Keep all financial-leverage actions non-ordering and SHADOW-only.
evidence: All three financial-leverage tables are empty.
Premarket XLF/FAS/FAZ gap values are null.
The dashboard reports FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.
proposals.risk: Low operational risk; may increase log volume. It must not synthesize signals from stale or missing prices.

proposals.title: Make funnel crossings and order lifecycle stages explicitly reconcilable
proposals.current: The funnel reports 13 raw crossings but 14 side-classified rows. Aggregate records distinguish blocked and accepted attempts, but the supplied review cannot identify the extra non-crossing event or fully join requested notional, acceptance, fill, and realization stages.
proposals.proposed: Add immutable fields for raw_threshold_crossed, confirmation_sequence_id, confirmation_count, gate_evaluated, requested_notional, projected_pretrade_exposure, projected_position_count, attempt_status, order_id, fill_id, and realized_lot_id. Add daily reconciliation assertions that report rather than alter trading behavior.
evidence: Funnel rows=14 and side totals=14, while raw_threshold_crossings=13.
Gate counts reconcile to 2 ORDER_ACCEPTED and 2 MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS.
There were 2 orders, 2 fills, and only 1 realized record, which are valid distinct lifecycle counts.
proposals.risk: Schema migration and downstream-report compatibility risk; no model behavior should change.

proposals.title: Add component-level forward attribution for geo, VIX, and premarket context
proposals.current: Decision rows record component adjustments, but evidence does not provide component-tagged forward outcomes or counterfactual scores without each adjustment.
proposals.proposed: For each decision snapshot, log the technical-only score, score with each context component added separately, final score, threshold-crossing counterfactuals, and 5/15/30/60-minute symbol returns. Deduplicate highly correlated minute observations into independent event episodes and require at least 12 completed episodes per symbol/component before considering calibration.
evidence: XOM average geo adjustment was 2.932 and its score reached 79.632 without a final action.
GLD average geo adjustment was 0.733.
Average VIX adjustments were near zero.
Five premarket snapshots were BULLISH, but no tagged outcomes were supplied.
proposals.risk: Counterfactuals may still be confounded and must not be interpreted as causal without sufficient independent episodes.

proposals.title: Instrument ZPTA trigger-conditioned outcomes and no-trade reasons
proposals.target: ZPTA SHADOW prediction and shadow-trade pipeline
proposals.current: There are 300 predictions and 272 resolved predictions, but zero shadow trades and no exit reasons. Models at the same horizon share identical sample counts and average returns, obscuring model-specific trigger performance.
proposals.proposed: Record per-model eligibility, trigger timestamp, score-threshold result, ensemble contribution, entry suppression reason, hypothetical entry price, horizon return, and hypothetical exit reason. Generate shadow-trade rows only for valid trigger-conditioned cases; preserve zpta_shadow_enabled=true and prohibit order routing because the asset is non-tradable in preflight.
evidence: zpta_shadow_trades is empty and zpta_exit_reason_counts is empty.
Asset preflight says tradable=false.
All model families at each horizon show identical sample counts and average returns despite differing stated logic.
Latest ensemble action was FLAT at 47.8 versus a configured entry score of 68.
proposals.risk: Hypothetical fills could overstate executable performance, especially with delayed OTC data; label them explicitly as non-executable SHADOW results.

proposals.title: Log cap headroom separately for cost basis and mark-to-market exposure
proposals.current: The dashboard snapshot shows $10,006.84 exposure against a $10,000 cap, while two attempts were blocked by position count. The evidence does not show whether the exposure excess was market drift or an order-sizing breach.
proposals.proposed: Expose read-only fields for accepted-order cost basis, current market-value exposure, pre-order headroom, projected post-fill exposure, and cap-block reason. Retain max_total_exposure=$10,000, max_open_positions=4, max_daily_realized_loss=$300, and all existing enforcement behavior.
evidence: Dashboard market-value exposure was $10,006.84 with four open positions.
Two attempts were blocked by MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS.
Only one new buy order was accepted, with $2,500 requested notional.
proposals.risk: Low; ensure dashboard calculations do not become an alternate source of truth for order enforcement.

proposals.title: Continue regime evidence collection without activating a regime gate

Do not alter order eligibility until at least 12 independent mapped outcomes exist in each regime being compared.
